output.subject: We've received your complaint about marketing offers and calls
output.body:
Dear ⟦CUSTOMER_NAME_1⟧,

Thank you for contacting us. We have received your complaint and want to confirm that we understand what you've told us.

You told us you have received three credit card offers from us this week and that you want them to stop. You also mentioned that you have been getting insurance calls that refer to Meridian Harbor, and that you're concerned your information is being shared with our partners. You've asked us to stop sharing your information and to opt you out of all marketing and data sharing, and you let us know you are prepared to close your accounts if this continues.

We understand how intrusive unwanted offers and calls can feel, and we're sorry for the frustration this has caused.

A specialist team is now reviewing your complaint, including your opt-out request and your concerns about the calls you've received. We will respond to you within 10 business days.

Thank you for taking the time to raise this with us.

Customer Care, Meridian Harbor Bank
notes_for_analyst: Decide whether the customer's opt-out request can be actioned now and whether to confirm that in the reply; the draft does not promise it.
Check whether the customer's information was in fact shared with any partners, and whether insurance calls mentioning the bank came from an actual partner.
Consider whether the insurance calls could be third parties impersonating the bank; if so, decide whether to add fraud-awareness guidance.
Check the customer's marketing preferences and why three credit card offers were sent this week.
Customer threatened to close their accounts; decide whether any retention or follow-up contact is appropriate.
Draft does not name the reviewing team, per acknowledge-only handling; confirm wording before sending.
